decision: Defer: focus is lost to body when the Try it view swaps in/out
reason: Minor; needs a focus-management design, not worth blocking content work

decision: Defer: TrafficStream re-renders every frame even with zero dots; all scenes/sims bundled into every lesson page
reason: Minor perf; fine at 29 small modules

decision: Defer: two rapid arrow presses during smooth scroll can advance one step
reason: Minor; scroll still works

decision: Accept: diagram stays on step 1 without JavaScript
reason: Spec says text must stay readable without JS; diagram is progressive enhancement

decision: Node boxes are 72x32 with labels capped at 12 chars and bounds/overlap checked in validateScene
reason: Review found silent layout breakage would be copied into 23 lessons

decision: indexes: show index lookups as ~log2(n) checks (10, 13, 17, 20) against full-scan row counts
reason: Intuition-level; real B-trees read pages with high fan-out so real counts are lower
evidence: lesson text says numbers differ in practice

decision: latency-vs-throughput: bar values (100 ms, 10/100/400 req/s etc.) are illustrative, not measured
reason: Teaching numbers chosen so relationships are visible

decision: sql-vs-nosql: picked the document store as the NoSQL example
reason: Most common NoSQL family for app developers; key-value/column/graph not covered
evidence: lesson text says NoSQL is an umbrella

decision: scaling: load percentages in the compare scene are illustrative
reason: Show the ceiling and failure contrast

decision: dns: lesson stops at one resolver path (root, TLD, authoritative) and omits DNSSEC and recursive vs iterative terminology
reason: Keep it beginner level

decision: estimation: 10M daily users, 10 requests each, peak = 3x average, 10% writes of 1 KB are assumptions
reason: Round illustrative numbers

decision: auth-sessions-tokens: JWT mentioned as the common token format; refresh tokens and OAuth are not covered
reason: Keep within intuition level

decision: monolith-vs-microservices: states a balanced view rather than recommending microservices
reason: Avoid a one-sided claim

decision: pub-sub: Kafka named as an example of an event streaming platform
reason: Well-known example; no deep dive

decision: Skip: replication scene still draws primary->r2 after failover
reason: Cosmetic; step caption explains failover

decision: rate-limiting sim: effective burst = max(burst, rate) because one tick is one second
reason: A smaller bucket would cap steady traffic below the refill rate in a per-second model

decision: consensus-raft: intuition level only (terms, votes, log commit); omits log matching, term rules for stale leaders, membership changes
reason: Keep it beginner-friendly per the spec

decision: cap-consistency: presents CAP as a choice during a partition, mentions tuning and weaker models only briefly
reason: Avoid the common "pick 2 of 3" misreading

decision: case studies: numbers (100M links/month, 100 reads per write, 62^7 keys) are illustrative
reason: Order-of-magnitude demonstrations

decision: observability: frames the three pillars as metrics=that, traces=where, logs=why
reason: Common teaching heuristic, not strict

decision: sagas: describes orchestration vs choreography in one sentence
reason: Deeper coverage out of scope

decision: consistent-hashing scene: edge k2->sd is drawn from the first step because scenes cannot hide edges per step
reason: No per-step edge visibility in the engine; step 1 caption says D is greyed

decision: Accept: 5 minor final-review findings deferred (readout window labels, BASE_URL links, no-JS diagram, TrafficStream idle redraw, sequence lane overlap cap, replication stale-window readout)
reason: Polish; none breaks the learning flow
